name: unity
description: Unity 6 (6000.x) traps a model gets wrong from memory — Rigidbody and Find* renames, the Unity 6 torque change, Cinemachine 3 class names, Input System project-wide actions enabling every map, Awaitable cancellation, batch-mode CI builds and build profiles, NavMeshSurface/NavMeshLink — plus a read-only .meta/GUID checker that exits 1 when files were moved, renamed or copied outside the Editor without their .meta.
